datasets.name: punctuality
queryLines:
SELECT service_date, hour, concat(CAST(dayofweek_iso AS STRING), ' ', date_format(service_date, 'E')) AS weekday,
  route_label, mode, mode_group, arrivals, early, on_time, late, avg_delay_s * arrivals AS total_delay_s
FROM (SELECT *, weekday(service_date) + 1 AS dayofweek_iso FROM gold.route_ontime_hourly)

datasets.name: regularity
datasets.displayName: Headway regularity by route and hour
queryLines:
SELECT service_date, hour, route_label, mode, mode_group, headways, bunched, headway_cv,
  avg_scheduled_headway_s / 60 AS avg_scheduled_headway_min, avg_actual_headway_s / 60 AS avg_actual_headway_min
FROM gold.headway_regularity

datasets.name: bunching
queryLines:
SELECT service_date, mode, mode_group, route_label, stop_name,
  from_utc_timestamp(arrival_at, 'Pacific/Auckland') AS arrived_at,
  leading_vehicle_id, vehicle_id, round(actual_headway_s / 60, 1) AS actual_headway_min,
  round(scheduled_headway_s / 60, 1) AS scheduled_headway_min
FROM gold.bus_bunching_events

datasets.name: vehicles
queryLines:
SELECT vehicle_id, coalesce(route_label, 'Not in service') AS route, mode, mode_group, latitude, longitude,
  occupancy_status, position_at_local, snapshot_at
FROM gold.vehicle_latest

datasets.name: alerts
queryLines:
WITH current AS (
  SELECT * FROM silver.service_alerts
  WHERE __END_AT IS NULL
    AND last_seen_at >= (SELECT max(last_seen_at) FROM silver.service_alerts) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
)
SELECT a.alert_id, a.effect, a.cause, a.severity_level, a.header_text,
  from_utc_timestamp(a.active_start_at, 'Pacific/Auckland') AS active_from,
  from_utc_timestamp(a.active_end_at, 'Pacific/Auckland') AS active_until,
  count(DISTINCT e.route_id) AS routes_affected, count(DISTINCT e.stop_id) AS stops_affected
FROM current a LEFT JOIN silver.service_alert_entities e USING (alert_id)
GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: benchmark
queryLines:
SELECT route_short_name, coalesce(route_label, route_short_name) AS route, comparison_basis, our_trips,
  our_punctuality, our_punctuality_low, our_punctuality_high,
  coalesce(official_same_period_punctuality, official_recent_punctuality) AS metlink_punctuality,
  difference_pp, reference_within_interval,
  concat(CAST(official_recent_from AS STRING), ' to ', CAST(official_recent_to AS STRING)) AS metlink_period
FROM gold.punctuality_benchmark

datasets.name: hotspots
queryLines:
SELECT h3_cell, latitude, longitude, routes, peak_speed_kmh, midday_speed_kmh, peak_slowdown_pct,
  peak_samples
FROM gold.congestion_hotspots

datasets.name: shortfalls
queryLines:
SELECT route_label, from_stop_name, to_stop_name, day_type, hour, trips, round(scheduled_s) AS scheduled_s,
  median_actual_s, suggested_extra_s, excess_trip_minutes
FROM gold.timetable_shortfalls

datasets.name: quality
queryLines:
SELECT run_at, check, subject, status, round(value, 3) AS value, threshold, detail
FROM ops.data_quality_results
WHERE run_at = (SELECT max(run_at) FROM ops.data_quality_results)

datasets.name: usage
queryLines:
SELECT usage_date, billing_origin_product AS product, sum(usage_quantity) AS dbus
FROM system.billing.usage
WHERE usage_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
GROUP BY ALL

lines: **Bunching**: a vehicle arrives less than a quarter of the scheduled headway after the one in front. **Headway CV**: standard deviation of (actual - scheduled headway) divided by the mean scheduled headway; lower is more regular.
